sections.Intro: This remedy is indicated in cases of metabolic disorders and respiratory issues. It is useful in cases of gout and rheumatism, especially when there is a tendency to deposits in the joints. There is a general feeling of weakness and debility. It is also useful in cases of chronic bronchitis.
sections.Head: Headache, with a sensation of weight in the forehead. Vertigo.
sections.Stomach: Appetite poor. Nausea. Heaviness and pressure after eating.
sections.Urinary: Frequent desire to urinate. Scanty, dark urine. Deposits in the urine.
sections.Respiratory: Shortness of breath on motion. Violent cough, with a sensation of oppression in the chest.
sections.Extremities: Aching and lameness in the limbs. Pain and swelling in the joints. Gouty deposits.
sections.Relationship: Compare: Ammonium carbonicum; Lithium carbonicum; Guaiacum.
